proposal.reason: Refactors RAS hang diagnostics end-to-end: replaces legacy COMMS-embedded diag blobs with runtime-state records and RAS_COLL_DIAG flow, rewrites analyzer/report persistence for v2 runtime data, updates monitor-triggered/local diagnostics execution, and removes old diag.cc paths. Changes are substantive within RAS diagnostic control traffic and failure-analysis behavior, with no separate independent feature-module change.
